title: PDF export
description: Metadata of a rendered PDF stored as an artifact; the bytes are retrieved through the artifact API.

artifact_id.description: Content address of the PDF in the artifact store.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored artifact.

pdf_standard.description: Conformance target declared in the LaTeX document metadata, such as ua-1.

engine.description: LaTeX engine that produced the PDF.

toolchain.description: Versions of the components that shaped the output; they are part of the cache key.
